mathematical_definition: residual_t / (ewma_vol_t * c_t), where residual is the same Kalman filter's pre-update innovation (price_t - predicted_level_t) and the denominator is NaN-guarded to np.nan wherever ewma_vol <= 1e-8 -- volatility-normalized Kalman residual (z-score-like)
numerical_stability_notes: Denominator forced to NaN (via np.where) whenever ewma_vol <= 1e-8, guarding division by near-zero volatility
missing_value_policy: NaN wherever ewma_vol is NaN (its own 1-bar warmup) or <= 1e-8 (division guard), never zero-filled
